entities.name: Orion
entities.description: A recruit who survived the initial expedition into The Silence, eventually witnessing the existence of the beast-beings.
entities.quote: Orion. Barely twenty-one. A rookie, freshly recruited. His name echoed through the ranks like an insult.

entities.name: The agency
entities.role: Monitors the barrier known as The Silence
entities.description: An organization that observed the invisible barrier known as The Silence for decades before sending an expedition force.
entities.quote: For decades, the agency watched the invisible barrier. A silent wall standing in plain sight, untouchable by satellites, undisturbed by storms.

timeline_events.title: The Opening of The Silence
timeline_events.description: The invisible barrier monitored by the agency opened, allowing a military task force to enter an unknown world.
timeline_events.quote: And one day, The Silence opened. The task force stood ready at its edge. Elite men and women handpicked from decades of service.
